retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast pop portrait featuring a subject with neon face paint against a chaotic splatter background, anchored by a lower text block with mixed distressed and script fonts.
triggerTerms: face paint portrait with distressed text

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered close-up portrait of a subject with platinum blonde hair and vibrant, geometric neon face paint. The background is a high-key, blurred explosion of pink, orange, and yellow paint splatters. The bottom third is a distinct light pink horizontal band containing layered, multi-style typography with paint-drip textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face paint mirrors the chaotic splatter of the background
High-key lighting creates a halo effect around the platinum hair
Horizontal divider separates the photographic subject from the graphic text block
Color palette is unified across face paint, background, and typography
coreInvariants: High-saturation pink and orange splatter motifs
Platinum blonde hair with high-volume styling
Lower horizontal text band with a light pink base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the top two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the vibrant face paint serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the large distressed title, and then scan the smaller metadata text above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with color and texture, though the light pink text band provides a brief visual rest.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon Green and Orange (face paint and splatters)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation and high value, creating a bright, energetic feel.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses heavy, distressed block letters with internal paint-drip textures
Secondary text uses clean, spaced-out sans-serif with multi-colored fills
Script elements are fluid and hand-drawn in appearance
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title have jagged, eroded edges to simulate wet paint
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a clean, multi-colored sans-serif, a fluid script, and a heavy distressed display face.

preserve: Distressed texture of the main title
Multi-colored fill of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the distressed, painterly feel of the main title
Base for the geometric sans-serif metadata

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person with platinum blonde hair and neon geometric face paint against a blurred pink and orange paint splatter background. Leave the bottom third as a solid light pink band.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three layers of text to the bottom band: a multi-colored sans-serif at the top, a pink script in the middle, and a large, distressed, paint-textured display font at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the face paint geometric and neon?
Is the background a high-key splatter?
Does the bottom band contain three distinct font styles?
Is the main title distressed with paint textures?

adjustableVariables: Color palette of the text band
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text band is clearly separated from the image
Verify the distressed texture is visible in the main title
Check that the face paint colors coordinate with the background
Confirm the hair has a high-key, glowing quality
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait with neon face paint + splatter background + multi-style textured typography band.
